label: Brow continuity

range.endpoint_anchor: brow component separation: -35 = pooled modern [E], 0 = common modern mixed pattern, +100 = torus frontalis (Krapina / gorilla [S-qual.]); gracile modern -75 [E]

region.mask_rule: frontal bone band above the orbits, crosswise profile; bone layer of the layered head stack

semantics: Crosswise brow profile: split superciliary components (glabellar dip, midorbit waist) <-> one level, unbroken torus. 0 = the common modern mixed pattern; pooled modern -35 [E]; +100 = torus frontalis (Krapina, gorilla [S-qual.]). A SHAPE axis, independent of size: a small continuous bar and a huge split brow are both buildable. A bone-layer slider in the layered head stack (blueprint section 7.4).
